services.desc: Our Murrells Inlet / Myrtle Beach kayak rentals and tours offer a wealth of knowledge, fun, and exploration! services.desc: Enjoy a Jet Ski Eco-Tour with one of our jet ski guides! Jet Ski Single - $159 Tandem Jet Ski - $169 Tour Information Departs: 8:30am Returns: 10:00am About Our guides will lead our guests through the Inlet as we pass million-dollar homes and make our way out into the Atlantic Ocean.
